sections.text:
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
every month as indicated by M1 in the title block.

The pump takes suction from condensate
storage tank and provides water for vessel backwash and rinses, resin sluicing,
and chemical dilution.

The first draft initiated by eng.
Tarek Abd Elmonem Mahmoud, tested by eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Shaker, accepted by eng. Mohamed Helmy Habib, approved by eng. Mohamed El-tahawy Mostafa 
head sector of Shoubra
El-Khimah PS 4x315MW

هذه الوثيقة معتمدة من قبل المهندس. 
عفاف إبراهيم الديب رئيس قطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة CEPC MPIS 
منسق ومراجعة م. ناجح سليمان شوشة .

يجب إصدار أمر العمل و
يجب أن يكون موظفو الصيانة المؤهلون فئة السلامة المناسبة

Safety fence with caution
marks surrounding the work area

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker for
electrical equipments
Close valve delivery and valve suction.
